title: Positive energy of a nonzero coefficient family
statement: For any natural number $n$ and any nonzero real coefficient family $p$ indexed by subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the sum $\sum_{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}p(S)^2$ is strictly positive.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a nonzero real coefficient family on subsets of the coordinate set
replaced: Let $n\ge0$ and let $(a_S)_{S\subseteq[n]}$ be real coefficients that are not all zero. Then $\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}a_S^2>0$.
